title: Repair café sign-out reminder
passage: Before you leave the repair café today, check the sign-out card in your tool kit. The card lists the small items that can go home with you. Please return those items next Saturday. The long scissors on the common table are not part of any kit. You may use them here, but hand them back to a volunteer before you go. If your kit contains a broken item, write its name on the card rather than replacing it yourself. The volunteer will check the card and give you a replacement from the supply drawer.
passageZh: 今天離開社區維修站前，請查看工具組裡的借用登記卡。卡上列的是可以帶回家的小工具，請在下週六歸還。公用桌的長剪刀不屬於任何工具組。你可以在這裡使用，但離開前須交回志工。工具組若有物品損壞，請在卡上寫下品名，不要自行替換。志工會看卡，再從備品抽屜拿替代品給你。
